source_note: v4 Service deployment-record and bake-gate contract source. stage-contracts.mjs, json-contract.mjs and operation-stacks.mjs are exact byte copies from that commit. deployment-contract.mjs is the raw producer file with exactly one declared import rewrite, recorded in import_rewrites: the bare package specifier is replaced with the vendored package entry because this repository consumes the dependency-free package source instead of installing a tarball. The loader reverses the declared rewrite, asserts the raw producer hash from producer_files and refuses any other difference.

package.name: @git-malu/stage-contracts
package.note: Packed 0.2.2 tarball pin for consumers that install @git-malu/stage-contracts. Version 0.2.2 adds the required observed.minimum_client_version floor to the v4 Service deployment record: the deploy job reads it back from the deployed API /health and the pinned validator requires a non-negative safe integer, so a producer that did not read the live value cannot write a record. This repository adds no dependency or tarball and records the tarball hash the entry comes from.

retired.vendor/service-artifact-contract.mjs: the Service parser copy is removed; the release chain verifies its own sealed release
